'''Tesuna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Army|army]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, he worked as a [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] and operated a stall in [[Camp Talanis]] in the [[Gormak Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. Tesuna wore [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] while at his stall and made use of a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. He had fair skin and brown hair and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tesuna first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game he serves as a Republic and Imperial heavy armor vendor on the planet Voss. His location is also marked on a map in [[Prima Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''.
